modes.P0_SHARED: No training; reuse exact shared per-site metrics
modes.P1_FULL: All parameters, initialized from shared best checkpoint
modes.P2_HEAD: Output MLP and only target-station embedding row; all other parameters frozen; no embedding weight decay

selection: Minimum per-station 2023 MAE including epoch0; same selected checkpoint for RMSE. Report selected_epoch0 fraction; selection-year improvements are not confirmation.
fairness: Same inputs, farms, seeds, 2022-only gradient updates, fine-tuning lr/budget, selection protocol for W0 and TF. Compare matching modes; choose a single mode per backbone using equal-farm 2023 MAE, no per-station mode cherry-picking.
interpretation: Fine-tuning gains, if any, do not validate the failed trajectory mechanism. Current dataset cannot support a matched independent-training claim without matching independent reruns.
